script.source: def tags = params._source['kibana.alert.rule.tags']; if (tags == null) { def kibana = params._source['kibana']; if (kibana != null && kibana['alert'] != null && kibana['alert']['rule'] != null) { tags = kibana['alert']['rule']['tags']; } } if (tags == null) return; if (tags instanceof String) { tags = [tags]; } for (def t : tags) { String s = t.toString(); if (s.startsWith('Appendix-B-')) { emit(s); return; } }
